svg.title: Input cost and total process CPU
svg.desc: Separate zero-based panels compare synchronous send cost and total process CPU for a 100,000-value burst. Medians of 15 rounds; CPU includes output and settling. Task per value, long-lived task, package: 798, 216, 16 ns/send and 280.81, 21.91, 1.72 ms CPU.
